approval_source.question_set: Production activation v1, step A3: scope of the upgrade notice

decisions.question: D11-Q03, D14-Q02 (UPG-002)
decisions.rule: The approved notice (activation at least 120,960 blocks after admission) applies to release handovers (schema 2) as well as to state-migration upgrades (schema 2). Operators install the named release before activation. Urgent problems use the emergency freeze; a halted chain uses restart, which has no notice.
decisions.note: The upgrade notice value was approved on 30 September 2026 (P01_E05_VALUES_2_2026-09-30.json); this record extends it to handovers.
